layout_notes: TLBEntry is 68 bytes, with 17 unsigned fields in header order; all32 entries cover03E69700..03E69F7F.
AIReg has eight known registers and one unknown trailing DWORD, confirmed by CPU reset memset36 bytes.
RSPShadowMemory+0xFC0 holds the task structure; +0x1000 is plugin IMEM. Physical SPMemory[0x4000]@0406B048 is owned by RSP.cpp.
SRAMData[0x40000]@0448C508 is owned by PIF.cpp and ends exactly at FlashCommand.
TLBEnabled@03E696F8 is runtime activation, distinct from CPU_TLBEnabled configuration@03E69364.

RSPShadowMemory observed accesses establish0x2000 bytes only; no clear/sizeof or direct3E67348 reference establishes a larger allocation. The following unreferenced0x2000 interval remains unexplained.
notable_original_behaviors: TLBRead masks Index to6bits for most accesses but uses unmasked Index in the PageMask complement access.
ROM byte/halfword reads apply an extra +2 for the upper half of a word.
Read32 has a second ROM mapping base13FCB4D0.
Unimplemented AI register reads return the supplied address.
RDRAM configuration reads shift the whole physical address by10 without masking; the resulting switch is unreachable for normal RDRAM-register addresses.
RAM write SEH catches a host page fault, invalidates/unprotects4 bytes, and retries the store.

write_word_refinement.semantic_correction: SP write DMA invalidates stride times the raw encoded block count, then copies raw count plus one blocks, exactly as the original instructions do. The previous reconstruction invalidated one extra block.
source_inferences: SP read transfer is the successful bounds branch; the error branch follows it.
AI, MI, SI and DPC register dispatch use switches.
Display-list time is stored before its count is cleared.
ROM transfer branches use local offset lifetimes, with the second fallback reusing the offset.
Flash write mutates the incoming value into its sector offset.
write_word_refinement.cross_unit_dependency: Natural SaveFunctionSignatures advancing candidate pointer is promoted in commit 2a8a585. The combined real link emits original LEA EAX plus CALL without stack argument or cleanup.

source_partition_diagnostic.evidence: Same Memory source, real complete link: COP1 or combined dynarec splits restore the Flash load order but exchange SIAddress/RDRAM order; expanded 27-unit partition restores SI order and exchanges Flash loads. No source partition was selected solely to force this function.

write_word_refinement.limitations: These diagnostics establish complete function structure and independently check operand identities. They do not establish whole-image byte equality, and the listed mismatches remain uncorrected.
